function.arguments: {"message":"Sure! To create a report grouped by tag, go to **Reports → Custom → New report** and choose **Tag** as the group‑by dimension. The report will show one row per tag, with the same metrics (count, average resolution time, etc.) that the default reports show per status. If a ticket has multiple tags, it will be counted once under each tag. Once you’ve set the grouping and metrics you want, you can save and schedule the custom report just like any built‑in report."}

arguments.message: Sure! To create a report grouped by tag, go to **Reports → Custom → New report** and choose **Tag** as the group‑by dimension. The report will show one row per tag, with the same metrics (count, average resolution time, etc.) that the default reports show per status. If a ticket has multiple tags, it will be counted once under each tag. Once you’ve set the grouping and metrics you want, you can save and schedule the custom report just like any built‑in report.
